confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Zurich price levels, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant, beer, coffee, and wine anchors are more reliable than accommodation. Hotel and hostel rates are July high-season estimates and include typical taxes and tourist fees, but they are the least certain values, especially the 1-star and 3-star hotel anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Zurich's position as one of Switzerland's and Western Europe's highest-cost cities, with price levels benchmarked against Geneva, Basel, and Bern and against high-cost Western European cities. Accommodation is set against Zurich's high-season hotel market in July.
